load_texture: load a texture file and get its unique ID using pybullet loadTexture
change_visual_shape_texture: change the texture of a visual shape using pybullet changeVisualShape with textureUniqueId
get_visual_shape_data: get visual shape data including texture unique IDs using pybullet getVisualShapeData
render_camera_image: render camera images in a loop using pybullet getCameraImage to visualize texture changes
connect_and_load_urdf: connect to pybullet GUI and load a URDF plane model using pybullet connect and loadURDF
